declarations.name: toByte
declarations.comment: The single sentence is correct but unwieldy. The `toInt`/`toLong` docs use a two-sentence pattern (main conversion, then edge-case sentence). Splitting here -- e.g. '...rounded toward zero), then narrowed to a `Byte` by keeping only its low-order 8 bits. A NaN value converts to `0` and a finite value outside the `Int` range converts to `Int.MinValue` or `Int.MaxValue`.' -- would match that pattern and reduce the parenthetical load.

declarations.name: toShort
declarations.comment: Same long-parenthetical concern as `toByte`. Same two-sentence split would improve consistency with `toInt`/`toLong`.
